post.description: Register this browser with a code, and give it its cookie.

503.description: The database cannot answer; try again

400.description: The code is not one that registers

post.description:
Write a whole batch, or none of it. A 422 names each bad line, as
FastAPI's own do: an item, package, location or volunteer that does not
exist, a fraction of an item counted in each or of a package, a retired
item or package received, a retired package taken sealed with none
left (docs/decisions/0003), or an item another line names in the same
package, or loose, too (repeated): send each item on one line for each
package it is in, sealed, and one loose (docs/decisions/0020). The
reply's X-Inventory-Build header names the build of the pages this
server serves, when it has one (page_builds.py).

parameters.name: X-Inventory-Build

schema.description: The id of the scan page's build that sent it: a build older than the server takes is answered 409 build_too_old, before the batch is checked. Only the scan page sends it; a batch without it is checked as any other
schema.title: X-Inventory-Build

parameters.description: The id of the scan page's build that sent it: a build older than the server takes is answered 409 build_too_old, before the batch is checked. Only the scan page sends it; a batch without it is checked as any other

503.description: The database cannot answer; try again

422.description: Refused: each problem's kind (type) and where (loc), never in words, which the page makes from the kind. A body that cannot be a batch at all gets FastAPI's own 422 (BodyRefusedReply), with pydantic's types and words, a line's package size among them (SizeProblem)

schema.title: Response 422 Save Batch Api Transactions Post

409.description: The key was used for another batch (key_reused), or the page's build is too old for this server (build_too_old): keep the batch, and load the page again

schema.title: Response 409 Save Batch Api Transactions Post

BackToCamera.title: BackToCamera
BackToCamera.description:
A volunteer tapped Back to camera on the scan page, as the camera's
picture was off the screen (frontend/src/scan/BackToCamera.tsx).

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: One line per item and package (or loose): a batch naming one on more than one line is refused, 422 with type repeated on each of those lines. None only in a report.

used_up.title: Used Up
used_up.description: Keys of open packages the volunteer says are used up, for an administrator to confirm (docs/decisions/0020): with a cut that took all they showed, or alone, in a report.

lengths.title: Lengths
lengths.description: What the volunteer says is really on open packages, by key, for an administrator to check (docs/decisions/0020): with a cut, or alone, in a report. Never an adjustment.

changed_from.title: Changed From
changed_from.description: The lines this batch held when its cart was put back under its key, before the volunteer changed it: what it holds less of than these, and than another batch recorded under the key, the volunteer took off, kept for an administrator when this batch is refused (409 key_reused). Compared with nothing else: a batch sent again with other lines here is the same batch.

BatchProblem.title: BatchProblem
BatchProblem.description:
One problem of a refused batch, shaped as FastAPI's own are: where,
and its kind, which the scan page words itself.

BodyProblem.title: BodyProblem
BodyProblem.description:
One problem of a body that cannot be a batch at all, in FastAPI's
own 422: pydantic's type, where, and words for whoever writes a
client, which the scan page does not show.

build.title: Build
build.description: The build the batch named, in X-Inventory-Build

oldest.title: Oldest
oldest.description: The oldest build of the scan page whose batches this server takes

BuildTooOldReply.title: BuildTooOldReply
BuildTooOldReply.description:
A batch from a build of the scan page older than this server takes:
not checked, nor saved.

CameraSession.title: CameraSession
CameraSession.description:
One session of the scan page's camera, sent as it closed, or as the
page was hidden with it open (frontend/src/scan/camera-report.ts).

CartDiscarded.title: CartDiscarded
CartDiscarded.description: A volunteer discarded the scan page's cart, once they confirmed it.

DifferenceAdded.title: DifferenceAdded
DifferenceAdded.description:
What a save refused as another tab recorded its cart first holds
more of, or new, put in the scan page's cart: by the page itself into
an empty cart, or by a volunteer's tap
(frontend/src/scan/recorded-elsewhere.ts).

build.title: Build
build.description: The id of the build of the scan page this server serves, as its frontend log line at startup names it; null with no build, or when Vite's dev server serves the pages

recorded.description: The transaction recorded under the key, as a batch sends one, for the page to show what differs; none if no volunteer's batch recorded it. Only one sending the key learns of it.

LabelEntry.title: LabelEntry
LabelEntry.description: A printed code, and the one thing it names.

LabelsRead.title: LabelsRead
LabelsRead.description:
Labels a camera session read, by what each names: an item, an
item's package, a place, or nothing the catalogue has (old stickers).

LengthReport.title: LengthReport
LengthReport.description:
What a volunteer says is really on an open package, for an
administrator to check (docs/decisions/0020, 2026-11-12).

package_id.title: Package Id
package_id.description: Sealed packages of this package of the item, kept sealed (docs/decisions/0020): `quantity` is a whole number of them, in units. None: loose units. An opening's lines name the package opened.

package_size.title: Package Size
package_size.description: Required when `package_id` is given, and only allowed then: the size, in the item's unit, the package was counted in, from the catalogue. Left out with `package_id`, it is refused as package_size_required; given without, as package_size_without_package. A line of a package resized since is refused (package_resized), never counted in the new size.

open_package_key.title: Open Package Key
open_package_key.description: An opening's: the key of the open package made, if its item tracks opened packages, made by the page so a later line can name it. One package a line, then. Any other line's: the open package it is taken from, cut loose, or moved whole.

whole.title: Whole
whole.description: A move's line taken from an open package: all that is left on it, `quantity`, moves with it, and it stays open there.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: The item's unit the page showed `quantity` in, from the catalogue. A line of an item counted in another unit since is refused (unit_changed), never recorded in the new unit.

LineRemoved.title: LineRemoved
LineRemoved.description: A volunteer removed a line from the scan page's cart.

OlderStorage.title: OlderStorage
OlderStorage.description:
What an older build left under its own key, saves not sent or a cart
with lines: a scan page found it as it loaded, a volunteer put one back
in the cart, discarded it or discarded one line of it, or the page put
one back in an empty cart itself (frontend/src/scan/older-builds.ts).

OpenPackageEntry.title: OpenPackageEntry
OpenPackageEntry.description:
A package opened and followed, not reported used up: one a cart can
take from where it is.

OtherSeparator.title: OtherSeparator
OtherSeparator.description:
A scan page's box refused as written with the decimal separator its
locale does not use, as Record was tapped: a point, a comma, or either
followed by three digits after a whole part above 0, as thousands are
grouped (web/forms.py).

OutOfDate.title: OutOfDate
OutOfDate.description:
A scan page's tab learned that a newer build is out (page_builds.py),
once a tab.

ReadingRuleEntry.title: ReadingRuleEntry
ReadingRuleEntry.description:
A reading rule (models.catalogue.ReadingRule): a unit as typed after a
number (units.rule_key), and what it reads as, by its symbol as searches
spell it (str(units.Reading)), or null: no unit. The page reads units by
them before its table, as the server does (units.respell).

RecordedBatch.title: RecordedBatch
RecordedBatch.description:
The transaction recorded under a batch's key, as a batch sends one
(Batch), with its id.

RecordedLength.title: RecordedLength
RecordedLength.description: A report of what is on an open package, as recorded (LengthReport).

RecordedLine.title: RecordedLine
RecordedLine.description:
A line of the transaction recorded under a batch's key, as a batch
sends one (Line), so the scan page compares it with what it sent.

RemovalUndone.title: RemovalUndone
RemovalUndone.description:
A volunteer pressed Undo after removing a line from the scan page's
cart, putting it back where it was.

RestPutBack.title: RestPutBack
RestPutBack.description:
A volunteer tapped Add to cart under a batch the inventory
refused for some of its lines, putting its other lines in the scan
page's cart (frontend/src/scan/add-the-rest.ts).

RetiredItem.title: RetiredItem
RetiredItem.description: A retired item with no stock left: named, never offered.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description:
How the page behaves, as administrators set it
(models.site_settings.ScanSettings).

SizeProblem.title: SizeProblem
SizeProblem.description:
A line's package_size refused by its own check, in FastAPI's own
422: one of the kinds there the scan page words itself.

device.description: Set by POST /api/devices when a device registers with a code. A browser sends its own: Authorize on /api/docs cannot set a cookie.
device.name: inventory_device
